name: boto3
description: Boto3 is a Python library for interacting with AWS services. It provides a simple and efficient way to manage resources and retrieve data.
rationale: Boto3 fills the gap in local-first tools by providing a lightweight, open-source alternative to AWS SDKs. By building this tool, developers can focus on their core tasks rather than learning proprietary APIs.
test_criteria: All unit tests must pass (pytest exit 0)
No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
